what: Pressing the menu button slides the panel in from the right over .75s (power3.out), a dark scrim spreads over the empty left in .3s, and .1s later the card on the scrim (QR · guide) grows from .8x with a slight overshoot over .5s. Closing by clicking the scrim, pressing Esc or the button clears the scrim and card first, then the panel leaves in .3s

options.fade: Duration of the curtain laying down and lifting (s), default 0.3
options.delay: Wait before a card grows (sec), default 0.1
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Toggle button — when open, the element gets is-open (turning the button into an X is up to the consumer’s CSS)
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Fixed layer holding panels and curtains
options.[data-fx-part=pop]: Card that pops up and grows over the overlay (optional)
options.fade-ease: The curve for the curtain laying down and lifting, default power1.out (the GSAP default — fadeIn ”swing” on a site that loads jquery.easing is easeOutQuad, which is the same as this)
